experiment: HLS LinUCB × bipartite assignment hybrid: independent train/test trajectories

ontology.A_scenario: 3 heterogeneous agents and 3 simultaneous tasks; each task has unit demand each period; three observable contextual demand modes; identical seeded evaluation paths and unit resource constraints.
ontology.B_mechanism: Pairwise disjoint LinUCB updates contextual reward coefficients from selected agent-task outcomes only. Agent competence is fixed and only shapes latent reward coefficients; no competence learning or transfer.
ontology.C_organization: LinUCB UCB-score matrix fed to joint bipartite optimizer. Greedy same-score counterfactual isolates matching, a separate online LinUCB+greedy run is also reported, oracle uses true current rewards, and fixed assignment is optimized on separate training trajectories.
ontology.policy_learning_vs_agent_learning: LinUCB estimator state changes; physical competence remains constant.

configuration.feature_vector: [intercept, context_mode_0, context_mode_1, context_mode_2] per agent-task pair
configuration.context_process: three-state Markov-like process: seeded initial mode; each next period stays with probability .70, otherwise moves uniformly to one of the other modes
configuration.reward_model_evaluator_only: r_ik(x)=theta_ik·x, theta intercept=.20+.55*competence[i,k], mode coefficient=.12*(((i+2*k+mode)%3)-1); deterministic, in [0,1], unknown to policies
configuration.linucb: existing LinUCBDisjoint, one single-arm disjoint model per agent-task pair; alpha=alpha_from_delta(.05); all pair contexts are observed; only selected-pair rewards update each model after the simultaneous matching
configuration.batch_feedback_boundary: one simultaneous matching then one observed reward per selected pair; updates are applied after the period. This is a multiple-play/batched composition of the single-play LinUCB update, not the original one-action-per-round protocol or its guarantee.
configuration.resource_contract: unit assignment per matched pair; agent and task each at most once; individual limits=1, collective and problem budget=3; all policies share this contract
configuration.fixed_baseline: single one-to-one map selected by enumerating all 3! mappings and maximizing summed reward over training trajectories; evaluated only on disjoint evaluation seeds
configuration.greedy_same_scores: counterfactual greedy matching on the exact score matrix produced by the main LinUCB-Hungarian learner at that period; does not feed counterfactual rewards into that learner
configuration.oracle: Hungarian optimizer on the evaluator-only true reward matrix; not deployable and never used for LinUCB updates

limitations: This is a synthetic contextual reward model, not empirical task/agent data.
The hybrid uses a simultaneous multiple-play/batched update of per-pair disjoint LinUCB models; published single-play guarantees do not transfer automatically.

The exact-score greedy row is a counterfactual matching ablation sharing the hybrid's scores; it is not an independently updated online policy. A separate LinUCB+greedy online policy is included as well.
The true-reward oracle is evaluator-only and not a deployable policy.
The fixed map has full reward labels on training trajectories but is evaluated on disjoint trajectories; its training information differs from selected-only LinUCB feedback.
Competence is constant, there is no learning-by-doing or transfer, and all assignments consume identical unit resources.
Computation times are local diagnostics, not portable performance claims.
